That vision helped spark OLIPOP, and it’s why we were honored to see Ben take the stage at The Wall Street Journal Global Food Forum alongside an incredible group of leaders shaping the future of food, health, and agriculture. In his session, “The Market for Prebiotic Soda Is Bubbling, OLIPOP Is on Top,” 🫧 Ben shared insights from OLIPOP’s journey—from early formulation and category creation to scaling a brand that’s helping redefine what modern soda can be.
